practiceReport.name: Elijah Simmons
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Remains in early stages of NFL 5-Step Concussion Protocol
practiceReport.beatComment: Simmons played 17 defensive snaps in Sunday's loss but did not appear in the box score. The defensive tackle has now entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and will need to be cleared by an independent neurologist to return to full-contact football activities.

practiceReport.name: Josh Hayes
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: 21-day IR practice window open (Week 1); awaiting current-week practice ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Hayes was a full participant in all three practice sessions during Week 11 prep, but he is not quite ready to return from a knee procedure that he underwent in late August. His next chance to play is Week 12 against the Panthers on Monday, Nov. 30.

practiceReport.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 89% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Missed prior game without practice participation — awaiting Wednesday report

practiceReport.name: Benjamin Morrison
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Both Morrison and Jacob Parrish (back) were injured in Sunday's loss to Detroit, forcing Tampa Bay to dip into its cornerback depth. Kevin Knowles picked up the extra snaps opposing Zyon McCollum, with Keionte Scott covering the slot.

practiceReport.name: Jacob Parrish
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (81% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Exited prior game with injury and did not return — awaiting Wednesday practice evaluation
practiceReport.beatComment: Parrish exited Sunday's Week 11 game against the Lions after sustaining a back injury. The 22-year-old has played in nine games in 2026, recording 40 tackles (33 solo) and 14 pass deflections, including two interceptions.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Mohamed Kamara
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Kamara suffered a sprained left knee in the Buccaneers' preseason finale against the Jaguars last Friday. The linebacker was promptly waived with an injury designation and cleared waivers. Kamara will now spend the entirety of the 2026 regular season on IR unless he is waived with an injury settlement.
